source_row.rationale: Tall man lettering is a labeling convention that visually emphasizes (through capitalization) the distinguishing letters between look-alike, sound-alike (LASA) medication names, such as hydrOXYzine and hydrALAZINE, helping draw attention to the key differences and reduce the risk of selecting or administering the wrong medication due to name confusion.

source_row.source_name: ISMP — Tall Man Lettering for Look-Alike, Sound-Alike Drug Names
